x: In the Surrey County Junior Championships at Warlingham on January 13th, Chris Steer (8th) Tony Fairclough (10th), Eric Penny (28th) and Philip King (42nd) were placed 6th in the team race.

Tony Fairclough proved too strong for the other two youths and finished third, a minute behind the winner. Eric Penny and Philip King were two of several runners that went off course, but fortunately this did not affect the Championship result.
Laurie O'Hara ran well to finish 5th in this long '5',Charlie Walker and Chris Keavey completing our scoring three. Phil King, Charlie Smart and Ron Langheim made up our much depleted team.
Laurie O'Hara (3rd) Trevor Hart (6th) and Mike Shingles (9th) easily took the team prize on this hilly course. Phil King ran very well in leading home the 'B' team which brought up the rear.
There were at least two or three 'A' team runners watching and the usually everfaithful "supporting cast" was completely missing except for Philip King.
